exposure: Triple I (Intrauterine inflammation or infection or both)
outcome: death due to early onset sepsis
cohort: Neonates born at Flushing Hospital Medical Center between November 2012 and January 2020 to mothers with intrapartum fever and a gestational age >35 weeks.
finding: Higher maternal Tmax correlated with neonates having sepsis ruled in (SRI), and SRI neonates were significantly more likely to require resuscitation.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not significantly associated with sepsis ruled in (SRI) or sepsis ruled out (SRO) groups.
